text:
maria: Quick Q — where's the best saved search/dashboard for looking at logs for acme-corp org, model 'gpt-acme-gen', route '/generate' in eu-west-1? Trying to triage some 5xx spikes. Also, how do I save a query so PMs can view? Thanks :wave:

kevin: Try the Route Insights dashboard — https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/route-insights
I usually run this logsearch first:

```logquery
org:acme-corp AND model:gpt-acme-gen AND route:"/generate" AND region:eu-west-1
| status >= 500
| sort ts desc
```

Then click "Save search" (top-right) and name it `acme/gpt-acme-gen:/generate/eu-west-1/5xx` — our naming convention makes it easy to find and hook alerts. :thumbsup:

maria: perfect — thanks. any tips for reducing noise? some of these 5xx look like retry storms from the client SDK.

tanya: If retries are noisy, try filtering them out: add `AND NOT message:"retrying"` or use `and attempt>1` if `attempt` is indexed. Also look for `error_type` tag in logs. For alerting, create a saved search for the error subset, then a metric rule. Quick example we use:

```yaml
# example alert rule (pseudo)
condition: count(status >= 500) > 5
window: 5m
group_by: [region, model]
notify: ["#eng-oncall", "#product-owner"]
```

Tune the threshold per-model (gpt-acme-gen historically has low baseline).

sre-bot: Saved search created: `acme/gpt-acme-gen:/generate/eu-west-1/5xx` (id: ss-20260301-8b). To edit go to Console -> Observability -> Saved Searches.

kevin: FYI I added that saved search as a panel to Route Insights dashboard (panel id: 42). If you want a direct link to the panel: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/route-insights?panel=42

maria: I'm getting a permissions error when I click the dashboard link. @kevin can you share or add the `acme-eng` team?

kevin: Done — gave view access to group `acme-eng`. Should work now.

maria: can confirm, I can see the saved search and logs now. I'll triage and post root causes here.

kevin: thanks — if you want I can add a short saved query that excludes retries and another that isolates true 5xx from upstream services.

maria: please do that, would help reduce alert fatigue. :pray:
